# Send Christopher a comma-separated list of David Fincher movies from Simple Note

# <playbook_cite>Following entry [abc123]: applying this strategy</playbook_cite>
# <uncertainty>Not sure how many Fincher movies to include; will include all matches in the note.</uncertainty>

# Login to Simple Note
simple_note_password=None
for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if a['account_name']=='simple_note':
        simple_note_password=a['password']
        break
simple_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='joyce-weav@gmail.com', password=simple_note_password)['access_token']

# Fetch the movie recommendations note
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1608, access_token=simple_token)
content = note['content']

# Extract movie titles directed by David Fincher
fincher_titles=[]
current_title=None
director=None
for raw_line in content.splitlines():
    line = raw_line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    if line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('-'):
        # metadata lines
        if line.lower().startswith('- director:'):
            director = line.split(':',1)[1].strip()
            # capture if current_title is set
            if current_title and director == 'David Fincher':
                if current_title not in fincher_titles:
                    fincher_titles.append(current_title)
        continue
    # title line
    current_title = line

print('Fincher_titles', fincher_titles)
msg = ', '.join(fincher_titles)
print('Message_to_send', msg)

# Login to phone
phone_pass=None
for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if a['account_name']=='phone':
        phone_pass=a['password']
        break
phone_username='3155673041'
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username=phone_username, password=phone_pass)['access_token']

# Christopher phone number from contact search
christopher_phone=None
contacts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Christopher', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('contacts_page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    contacts.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# pick the Christopher contact (first_name exact match)
for c in contacts:
    if c.get('first_name')=='Christopher' and c.get('phone_number'):
        christopher_phone = c['phone_number']
        break
print('Christopher_phone', christopher_phone)

# Send text message
send_resp = apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=christopher_phone, message=msg, access_token=phone_token)
print('send_resp', send_resp)

# Complete task
complete_resp = apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=msg)
print('complete_resp', complete_resp)
